candidates.title: keynote-parser: arbitrary file write (zip-slip) via unsanitised ZIP member names in .key files
candidates.body_excerpt: ## Summary `keynote-parser` writes ZIP member names verbatim to disk when unpacking a `.key` file, with no `basename()` stripping, no `realpath()` confinement check, and no rejection of absolute paths. An attacker-supplied `.key` archive can write arbitrary files anywhere the process has write access — well outside the designated output directory — on both Windows and POSIX systems. Tested version: **1.14.5.0** --- ## Vulnerable code **`keynote_parser/file_utils.py` — `dir_file_sink.accept()`:** ```python ensure_directory_exists(target_dir, filename) # makedirs on traversed path — outside target target_path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename) # '..' hops / absolute path drops the base open(target_path, "wb").write(data) # arbitrary write at attacker-controlled path ``` `zip_file_reader()` (lines 92–105) re-decodes member names cp437→UTF-8 (a no-op for ASCII) and skips only names ending in `/`. Every other name — including `../../../etc/cron.d/pwn`, absolute Windows paths, or UNC paths

candidates.title: [Bug]: --stream 收尾对 verified_claims 做切片崩溃：get_summary() 返回计数（int），任务成功即异常退出
candidates.body_excerpt: ### 结论 `vulnclaw solve --stream` / `vulnclaw run --stream` 在任务**已经成功**（flag 已取证、evidence 已落盘）之后抛 `TypeError` 退出，收尾的 `emit_complete_event()` 从未执行，进程退出码 1。 **严重性：低。** 不影响取证、报告生成与数据落盘——崩溃发生在这些动作之后； 仅影响 CLI `--stream` 模式的消费方（退出码 1、收不到 `complete` 事件）。 普通用户通过 REPL / TUI 使用时不经过该代码路径。修复成本约 2 行。 ### 环境 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | OS | Windows 11 (10.0.26200) | | Python | 3.14.5 | | VulnClaw | 0.4.1（`pip install vulnclaw`，PyPI wheel，源码零改动） | | LLM | deepseek-v4-pro（OpenAI 兼容接口） | | 相关分支 | `main`（3811 行）与 `dev`（3813 行），2026-10-26 均未修复 | ### 触发条件 只在 `verified_claims` 计数 > 0 时触发，即"真的验证成功过至少一条结论"才崩；计数为 0 时 `(0 or [])` 会退化成空列表，一切正常。所以它在失败运行里隐形、**在成功运行上必现**，CI 也容易漏掉。 ### 与模型供应商无关 - `solve`（非 `--stream`）的 `on_event` 崩溃发生在任何模型调用之前：把供应商换成不可达地址 + 假 key，**1.2 秒内**仍然复现同一个 `UnboundLocalError`，说明它根本不依赖模型。 - `--stream` 的 `TypeError` 只取决于"本次运行是否产出 ≥1 条 verified claim"：用同一个假供应商（0 条 claim）跑同一目标，**不抛** TypeError，正常输出 `{"type":"complete","summary":"⊘ not reached — steps=0 evidence=0","result":{"findings":[]}}`，退出码 0；换回可用

candidates.title: TaintAnalyzer misses taint inside expressions and treats html.escape as a shell sanitiser
candidates.body_excerpt:
## Problem `TaintAnalyzer.analyze` reports `SAFE` for code where user input reaches a shell sink, as long as the input is wrapped in an expression instead of being passed as a bare name. It also counts `html.escape` as a sanitiser for shell sinks. Found in an October 2026 correctness audit. x = input()
os.system("ls " + x)', "f-string": 'import os
x = input()
os.system(f"ls {x}")', "html.escape": 'import os, html
x = input()
y = html.escape(x)
os.system(y)', "helper": 'import os
x = input()
y = print_and_return(x)
os.system(y)', "bare name": 'import os
x = input()
os.system(x)', # control "direct": 'import os
os.system(input())', # control } for name, code in cases.items(): r = t.analyze(code) print(name, r["status"], len(r["vulnerabilities"])) ``` | Case | Observed | Expe

candidates.title: Vulnerability issue
candidates.body_excerpt: Hi Team, Do we have plan to fix it. All versions of archiver allow attacker to perform a Zip Slip attack via the "unarchive" functions. It is exploited using a specially crafted zip archive, that holds path traversal filenames. When exploited, a filename in a malicious archive is concatenated to the target extraction directory, which results in the final path ending up outside of the target folder. For instance, a zip may hold a file with a "../../file.exe" location and thus break out of the target folder. If an executable or a configuration file is overwritten with a file containing malicious code, the problem can turn into an arbitrary code execution issue quite easily. https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search/results?form_type=Advanced&results_type=overview&search_type=all&cpe_vendor=cpe%3A%2F%3Aarchiver_project&cpe_product=cpe%3A%2F%3Aarchiver_project%3Aarchiver&cpe_version=cpe%3A%2F%3Aarchiver_project%3Aarchiver%3A5.3.1

candidates.title: Build supply chain integrity
candidates.body_excerpt: ## Audit Reference **Findings:** H-05, H-06, M-11 | **Severity:** High/Medium | **File:** `app/build.gradle.kts` ## Description The nodejs-mobile binary is downloaded at build time with no SHA-256 checksum verification. The ZIP extraction has no Zip Slip path traversal guard. No Gradle dependency verification metadata exists. Combined, a compromised download could inject a malicious `libnode.so` into the APK or overwrite source files. ## Fixes - [ ] H-05: Add SHA-256 integrity verification after downloading `nodejs-mobile-v18.20.4-android.zip` - [ ] H-06: Add canonical path validation before ZIP extraction (`canonicalPath.startsWith(extractDir)`) - [ ] M-11: Bootstrap Gradle dependency verification (`./gradlew --write-verification-metadata sha256`) ## Files - `app/build.gradle.kts` - `gradle/verification-metadata.xml` (new, generated)
